name: @omnibazaar/service-desktop
description: Cross-platform desktop launcher for an OmniBazaar service node (onboarding, dependency provisioning, supervised service-node.js, tray UI).

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.renderer.json && node scripts/copy-renderer-assets.js
scripts.dist:linux: npm run build && npm run stage:validator && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:win: npm run build && npm run stage:validator && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:mac: npm run build && npm run stage:validator && electron-builder --mac
